newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - North Carolina.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - North Carolina.

text.p: Sealed bids will be received by the State Treasurer in the Albemarle Building, 4th Floor Room 411, 325 North Salisbury Street, Raleigh, North Carolina 27603-1385 until 11:00 A.M., North Carolina Time,
such bids to be opened in public at said time and place on said day, for the purchase of $195,000,000 Capital
Improvement Bonds, Series 1997 of the State of North Carolina (the State''), dated January 1, 1997, and
maturing (subject to the right of prior redemption)
The approving opinion of Poyner &Spruill, L.L.P., Raleigh, North Carolina, Bond Counsel, will be furnished to the purchaser without cost.

Copies of the Official Statement and the Notice of Sale and Bid Form relating to the bonds may be obtained from the Office of the State Treasurer (919-733-3064). Each bid must be submitted on a bid form in the Notice of Sale and Bid Form.
